description: This file defines a React component called AuthShell which provides a styled, two-panel authentication page layout with animated background effects and switching modes between login and signup. It includes subcomponents for panels and miniature indicator pills, and utilizes Tailwind CSS for styling and Framer Motion for animations.

classes.name: Panel
classes.description: A subcomponent rendering a stylistic panel with title, subtitle, icons, and call-to-action button, visually indicating whether it's active or inactive.

classes.name: MiniPill
classes.description: A small badge component with an icon and label, styled based on whether it's active.

methods.name: AuthShell
methods.description: Main exported React component for rendering the authentication layout with animated accent sides, switchable modes, and nested panels.

methods.name: Panel
methods.description: Subcomponent rendering individual side panels with animated transitions and call-to-action buttons.

methods.name: MiniPill
methods.description: Subcomponent for rendering small icon-labeled badges.
